summary: Contains the text of a statement signed on 29 August 2012 by the IEEE Standards Association, the IAB, the IETF, the Internet Society and the W3C. It affirms a set of principles, known as OpenStand, for open, jointly developed global standards. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Several big groups that make rules for the internet signed a note together saying how good rules should be made: openly, fairly, and with everyone invited.

questions: what are the modern paradigm for standards principles
